description: This Java source file defines the class 'ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter', which acts as an adapter to convert 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' objects to and from an 'Adaptable' representation within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation, signal mapping, and type criterion retrieval.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class that adapts 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' signals into 'Adaptable' objects and vice versa, implementing specific mapping strategies and signal conversion methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate 'ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter' with a provided 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Returns a string criterion used to identify response message types based on a 'TopicPath'.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' signal and channel into an 'Adaptable' object using the signal mapper.
